LanguageData.MSS_CFP_Settings_XenotypeOnJoin: Change xenotype when a pawn joins
LanguageData.MSS_CFP_Settings_XenotypeOnJoin_Tooltip: When a pawn joins your faction as a colonist during play, replace their xenotype with the one chosen below. Slaves are not affected until they are freed. Temporary guests, starting colonists and newborns are not affected. Needs Biotech.
LanguageData.MSS_CFP_Settings_JoinXenotype_Tooltip: Only xenogene (non-inheritable) xenotypes can be chosen. The pawn's current xenogenes are replaced; their endogenes stay.
LanguageData.MSS_CFP_Settings_DarkRevelationChance: Dark revelation: chance of other Anomaly research instead of a psychic ritual: {0}
LanguageData.MSS_CFP_Settings_DarkRevelationChance_To: The "dark revelation" ritual reward normally unlocks the next psychic ritual. This is the chance it unlocks a different Anomaly research project instead. When every psychic ritual is known, it always unlocks other Anomaly research. Needs Ideology and Anomaly.

LanguageData.MSS_CFP_DarkRevelation_NothingRevealed: The void was silent: there was no dark knowledge left to reveal.
